description: #499, on the ledger of integration-tests/budget-close-and-currency in both formats: an amount in another commodity than the budget's that no price converts (a budget-add and a posting in USD) is left out and reported as BudgetCommodityMismatch where it is written; the budget is closed from the month of its budget-close on, not before, and takes no activity after it (BudgetClosed).
